senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. preced. wds.) [to be strong, to recover.]

units: <cite ref="Sotah 34b:8">Sot. 34ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>י̇ה̇וש̇ע̇</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 13:17">Num. XIII, 17</cite>) <he>י֗ה֗ יוֹשִׁ֗יעֲ֗ךָ וכ׳</he> Yah save thee from &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 14a:14">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>עתידה … שיושִׁיעַ וכ׳</he> my mother shall bear a son who will deliver Israel; <cite ref="Sotah 11b:13">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>שמוֹשִׁיעַ</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 4</cite> <he>כשתּוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מאויבי</he> when thou shalt have saved me from my enemies.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 4:4">Ber. IV, 4</cite> <he>הוֹשַׁע וכ׳</he> help, O Lord &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00289"><he>הוֹשַׁעְנָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be saved, released. Midr. Till. l. c. אִוָּשֵׁעַ מן וכ׳ let me be delivered from my enemies, and I shall call the Lord the praised One. Tanḥ. Aḥǎré 12 (ref. to ויושע, Ex. XIV, 30) וַיִוָּשַׁע כתיב כביכול הוא נ׳ it may be read vayivvasha (and he was saved), He, as if it were, was delivered.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 14:30">Ib.</cite> <he>בעוה״ז הייתם נוֹשָׁעִים ע״י ב״א</he> in this world (the past) you were delivered through human agencies.
